title: Curate non-ES EWSR1 look-alike + fusion-negative confounder panel
context: M3 specificity confounder panel for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Curates non-ES EWSR1 look-alike fusions (e.g. EWSR1-WT1, EWSR1-NR4A3, EWSR1-ATF1/CREB1) and fusion-negative samples so the benchmark can measure specificity, not just sensitivity. Distinguishing these from true ES fusions is diagnostically important. All entries are open/accession-only with license records; compliance gate applies (no controlled-access/identifiable data).
objective: Curate a confounder panel of non-ES EWSR1 fusions and fusion-negative samples as licensed accessions, documenting the diagnostic importance of distinguishing them from ES fusions.
acceptanceCriteria: Includes non-ES EWSR1 fusions (e.g. EWSR1-WT1, EWSR1-NR4A3, EWSR1-ATF1/CREB1) and fusion-negative samples; each sourced + licensed.
Documents the diagnostic importance of distinguishing these from ES fusions.
Recorded as accessions + fetch recipe with re-identifiability check = pass; compliance reviewer confirms no controlled-access/identifiable data.
output: data/confounders/panel.tsv — non-ES EWSR1 look-alike + fusion-negative confounder accession/license records.
